thread:
sam: quick follow-up from the failover sim: split the lease signal into a tiny ownership blob for controller reads and a separate high-cardinality stream for traces. reduces controlplane churn.

elaine: agreed. what fields in the blob?

sam: owner, seq, expiry_ts, region_hint, schema_v. keep <256B. no histos.

pavan: ops question: if the writer sidecar dies, do we flip owners?

sam: no, region-agent keeps authoritative heartbeat and writer can mark blob as 'degraded'. controller treats degraded as authoritative until TTL expires.

pavan: add a short HMAC (48-64b) so controller detects corruption cheaply and can fetch authoritative payload when mismatch.

elaine: migration: write-through from old path for 14d, read-prefer new index only in canary regions.

sam: test plan: sidecar crash, network partition, clock skew +-1s, shadow-sample diffs at 0.1%. I'll draft RFC follow-up and seq diagram.

infra-bot: meeting scheduled: 1749006000 (calendar invite sent).
